assumptions: DATA-DEC-01 and DATA-DEC-02 are Approved, which is what the data package says gates the DB-00 merge and the start of DB-00 coding.
A migration never applied to any database is reversible foundation under the G0 constraint.

acceptance_results.criterion: Every required_before_freeze item is assessed against the shipped schema and fixture list, not against a fixture count.
The assessment states plainly that it establishes PRESENCE of an artifact and not that the artifact satisfies the intent behind the phrase, with the specific items where that gap is widest named.
No contract status changes anywhere in the repository.
Contracts with a co-owner are routed to that co-owner rather than proposed for promotion by A0 alone.
npm run check stays green with no test skipped.

tests.result: see evidence/VERIFICATION.md, which is machine-written and compared byte-for-byte against a live run

security_privacy_cost_impact: data classification synthetic-only; secrets required false; network policy deny-unless-declared. No provider call, credential, migration or customer-data effect. Cost impact none: no metered resource is touched.
migration_and_data_impact: None. No schema, migration, provider call, credential or customer-data effect; Gate G0 forbids all of them and this package changed none.
compatibility_impact: Pending re-derivation from the committed range; see the following commit.
known_limitations: CI runs against a postgres:17 service container with a shim that creates the auth schema, auth.uid() and the platform roles. That proves OUR policies still behave as written; it proves nothing about Supabase. service_role in the shim is a role we created WITHOUT bypassrls, while on the platform it ships WITH it -- the measurement that decided DATA-DEC-03 can only come from a provisioned instance.
db-migrate-upgrade and db-seed-replay fail rather than pass: there is no previous-release fixture and no global seed runner. An empty replay is not a passing replay.
The driver shells out to psql, present on the CI runner. No dependency was added; RFC-2026-001 forbids one and a test asserts it.
open_risks_or_blockers: Six of nine db targets cannot be exercised until a Postgres test instance exists. Until then no claim may be made that the migration applies cleanly or that RLS behaves.
rollback_or_forward_fix: Revert through a reviewed revert PR. The migration has never been applied to any database, so there is no deployed schema to roll back, and the command contract and lint are inert without one.
recommended_next_work_packages: Provision a Postgres test instance and wire a runner, which turns six refusing targets into real checks.
Disposition of the policy-shape decision in WP-0A-A0-007, which unblocks the first tenant table.
DB-01 once batch 000 is merged and the live harness runs.
reviewer_instructions: Run LC_ALL=C TZ=UTC make db-verify and confirm it FAILS, naming six targets and DB_TEST_URL.
Confirm no live target has a no-database mode that could report a pass.
Gut any one lint rule in scripts/db/run.mjs and confirm the suite turns red.
